functions.name: GetMultiMapFilePath
functions.plate_comment: Catalog path helper: appends /rockrobo/SharedMultiMapInfo to GetUserDataPath output; sets output[127]=0. Caller supplies 128-byte storage; no general arbitrary-path selection.

functions.name: SerializeMultiMapInfo
functions.plate_comment: Catalog serialization boundary: builds catalog path, calls generic PersistSave(type=1,path). This is not PersistSaveMapInfo. Callers do not consume the save result; this wrapper adds no transaction/durability guarantee.

functions.name: GetMapInfoPersistFileName
functions.plate_comment: ABI-level signature: r0 is hidden std::string result storage, r1 is signed persistence flag; original std::string layout deliberately opaque. flag=-2 selects /dev/shm/PersistData_Temp.data. Otherwise cached getenv(NAV_DYNAMIC_CONFIG_PATH) or /mnt/data/rockrobo is followed by /PersistData_, signed decimal flag and .data; no range restriction. Persistence -2 is not Grid temporary flag 12.

functions.name: PersistSave
functions.plate_comment: ABI boolean result is not a durability/completion acknowledgment. type==0 parses a flag from filename and delegates to asynchronous PersistSaveMapInfo. Nonzero types use synchronous protobuf encoding, join compression workers and write DIRECTLY to filename (binary output, no tmp/rename here). No subscriptions returns true without a write. SerializeToOstream result is ignored; open/close failure only changes stream state and can still return true. compress controls zlib; encrypt is recorded, not acted upon in this path.

functions.name: PersistSaveMapInfo
functions.plate_comment: Boolean means snapshot/enqueue accepted, NOT file save completed. Locks type-0 metadata; no subscriptions returns true without a write. Converts flags to bits at flag+8 and cancels older destinations. Capacity loop has outer 20000 ms deadline, 50 ms semaphore timedwait probes. Selects state 0 or UNKNOWN 6; cleans state-6 mapping/fd before reuse, sets state 1 and owner PID. Copies 0x468-byte metadata; payload starts at 0x470 and each region allocation rounds to 16 bytes. Each region has its OWN lock, callbacks 2/copy/3/unlock; not an atomic multi-region snapshot. Publishes fd/mapping/length, state 2; pthread_create passes root+8 task pointer and then pthread_detach, with no join. Allocation/thread failures reset state 0 and return false.

functions.name: PersistLoadMapInfoAndSave
functions.plate_comment: First buffer-aware loads source flag. If successful, cancels destination tasks then opens SOURCE FILE and copies through binary input/output streams directly to destination files. Does not serialize the possibly newer source buffer; no tmp/rename transaction. Returns initial load result; stream-copy failures do not replace it.

functions.name: GridStoreInit
functions.plate_comment: Observed initialization only; no original C++ class claimed. Allocates 25 pointer slots (100 bytes at store+0..8) and 25 36-byte metadata slots (900 bytes at store+12..20); clears both. Constructs 25 string slots at store+24 onward. First 12 are mobility_test_vmap,last_vmap,user_vmap0..9. Grid strings at store+72: flag0 /opt/rockrobo/cleaner/misc/mobility_test_map; flag1 /mnt/data/rockrobo/last_map; flags2..11 /mnt/data/rockrobo/user_map0..9; flag12 /dev/shm/tmp_map. Absolute strings verified against literal pool 0x26e1c..0x26e7c and .rodata 0x3f594..0x3f8a8. Constructor alone imposes no flag range check.

functions.name: GridFilenameSlot
functions.plate_comment: Returns address of one-word string slot store + 4*(*flag+18), NOT raw char*. No flag validation. Constructor binds flag0 mobility_test_map, 1 last_map, 2..11 user_map(flag-2), 12 /dev/shm/tmp_map. Cache index is separately flag+11; do not conflate string and pointer-table indexes.

functions.name: GridGetSavedBuffer
functions.signature: GridBufferRef * GridGetSavedBuffer(GridBufferRef * out, void * store, int * flag)
functions.plate_comment: Storage cache loader: index=*flag+11. Existing pointer bypasses file read, returns GridGetBuffer result. Otherwise obtains 1024x1024 buffer filled 0x80, copies GridFilenameSlot string and opens input mode 8. Calls GridReadDispatch, accepts if stream state &5 ==0. On allocation/open/stream failure drops same cache slot with base11 and sets out->valid=0. Header/scale/digest mismatch need not set stream state: can return valid=1 with initialized unchanged cells and retain cache. No lock around cache lookup/load/drop observed; dmb/ldrex/strex belong to string reference count, not cache synchronization. Close result is ignored. ABI explicit out pointer; original C++ class/layout unknown.

functions.name: GridDropSavedCaches
functions.plate_comment: Loops flags 1 through 11 inclusive with base index 11 and calls GridDropCacheSlot. Drops last_map and user_map0..9 caches only; excludes mobility flag0 and tmp_map flag12. No disk deletion; no synchronization in this loop. Outer caller scope not recovered.

functions.name: FUN_0001718c
functions.plate_comment: Storage boundary only; surviving unknown name/signature retained. Reset branch calls GridDropSavedCaches at0x172f2. A distinct saved-grid branch drops flags1..11 at0x175b8, reads selected flag from unknown owner state+0x15b0 then record+4, calls GridGetSavedBuffer at0x175cc, copies selected grid or fallback, and drops caches again at0x17646. This branch forces fresh saved-grid read; not proof all load paths do. No mutex call observed in this boundary. State/transform/algorithm semantics and unknown owner offsets intentionally not recovered. Decompiler aliases to imported string/symbol storage in owner-relative expressions are analysis artifacts, not literal accesses.

functions.name: GridSaveRuntime
functions.plate_comment: Saves manager slot index11 (runtime grid) to caller-supplied one-word string slot. Opens output mode0x10 and calls GridWriteV2. 0x12dd2-0x12de0 captures success from stream state &5 BEFORE std::filebuf::close; 0x12dbc returns captured bool in r0. Close return ignored. No temporary rename/fsync in this function, unlike separate persistence writer. Does not select a native flag or invalidate saved caches; caller is boundary 0x92e0, not recovered wholesale.

functions.name: MapFlowSaveMaps
functions.plate_comment: Under core+0x2c8 lock, calls MapFlowSaveGridState sequentially for destination flags; after first false, later entries are skipped. Only if all grid stages succeed calls PersistSaveMapInfo(vector). If that call returns false, deletes grids via SLAM virtual +0x70 for every destination; errors from deletes are ignored. No rollback of already-written grids on an earlier grid-stage failure. Persistence success is API acceptance, not proof background writes finished.

functions.name: MapFlowLoadSLAMMap
functions.signature: int MapFlowLoadSLAMMap(void * core, int native_flag, uint load_mode)
functions.plate_comment: Grid load (0x68544) must succeed before flag reconciliation. Signed native_flag > 1 updates shared catalog current flag at 0x68556; flag 1 uses manager byte +0x22 and saved flag +0x28 (0x687aa..0x687fa). Then per-map/config updates precede PersistLoadMapInfo at 0x685ba. Persistence failure returns zero without undoing grid/current flag/config changes. Success restores poses and downstream state before common unlock/resume cleanup. Locks core+0x2c8 and manager mutex from 0x170850 when threading enabled; no cross-file transaction or disk-write completion implied. Third argument is a mode, not a reconstructed C++ field.

functions.name: MapFlowUpdateBackupDb
functions.plate_comment: Prepared statement database+0x140, SQL global 0x120838: update bakmaps set map=? where id=?. Locks database+0x160; binds blob then signed ID (sign word from ASR #31), expects step 101. Success resets/unlocks +0x160. Error path at 0x2329e unlocks +0x178 instead: instruction-level observed discrepancy, not corrected by annotation.

functions.name: MapFlowWriteBackupDb
functions.plate_comment: Builds application map message through 0x8cddc, uses external DB ID native_flag-2. Looks up bakmaps via 0x23070; insert 0x22f84 if read failed or blob size is zero, else update 0x23210. Uses current application-map buffer at map object+0x30002c with size word+0x48002c. DB errors only logged; returns void, not success/failure.
